recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce CodeableReference for DeviceRequest.product solely to match the 2020 wording because that would conflict with the later canonical DeviceDefinition representation. A separate future review could consider whether DeviceRequest needs a canonical search parameter, but that is outside FHIR-26299.
issue_request: FHIR-26299 was a Published/Persuasive R4 change request from Orders and Observations asking DeviceRequest.code to support DeviceDefinition as well as Device, and to use CodeableReference(Device | DeviceDefinition).
initial_application: The Jira issue says the change was preapplied, and the 2020-05-04 OO HCP minutes record a 9-0-1 motion to accept the DeviceRequest code reference proposal as proposed and preadopted. Git commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 introduced the new-build DeviceRequest source with DeviceRequest.code typed as CodeableReference targeting Device and DeviceDefinition.
additional_context: Current source maps the old DeviceRequest.code name to DeviceRequest.product[x]. Later DeviceDefinition modeling work in FHIR-39389 required references to DeviceDefinition to use canonical form; commit e3ef4ee44f6a25130aeb63548e9bb2929e103299 changed DeviceRequest.product from CodeableReference(Device | DeviceDefinition) to product[x] with CodeableConcept, Reference(Device), and canonical(DeviceDefinition).
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the active DeviceRequest StructureDefinition already includes the requested DeviceDefinition choice, and the non-CodeableReference representation is explained by later canonical-resource modeling.

related_jiras.note: Changed references to DeviceDefinition toward canonical representation and directly explains the current DeviceRequest.product[x] shape.
Confirms the R5-era element was understood as CodeableReference(DeviceDefinition), but the WG rejected renaming it to DeviceRequest.device.
